base_commit_rule: must equal the reviewed and pushed commit recorded by the final release gate
objective: Run genuine two-stage Frozen-Qwen few-shot, DistilBERT and QLoRA validation for mandatory Level 2 N/D and Level 4 D only; the locally rejected rich condition is not expanded.

sealed_data_contract.selection_population: seen-aspect validation evidence inside each exact outer training scope

frozen_qwen_few_shot.demonstration_selection: stable SHA-256 order from the exact outer train fold with no retrieval or result-guided selection
frozen_qwen_few_shot.stage_1_demonstrations: two positive and two negative examples
frozen_qwen_few_shot.stage_2_demonstrations: one negative one neutral and one positive example
frozen_qwen_few_shot.sharing: the same demonstrations and thresholds are used across N and D

evaluation.decoder: aspect threshold followed by top-one sentiment plus thresholded runner-up

checkpoint_and_resume.checkpoint_publish: write sibling temporary directory, hash every file, write manifest, atomic directory rename
checkpoint_and_resume.score_publish: write immutable CSV then manifest with contract pair-identity and score hashes
checkpoint_and_resume.resume: accept only a complete artifact whose full contract and file hashes match
checkpoint_and_resume.interruption_boundary: only completed manifest-bearing units are reusable

replication.transport: OpenSSH/SCP using key authentication; no credential is stored in the repository

storage_budget.parallel_volume_policy: one independently audited 100 GiB volume and isolated output root per physical worker

basis.distilbert_candidate_checkpoints: 45 checkpoints at less than 0.28 GiB each
basis.qlora_candidate_checkpoints: 45 checkpoints at less than 0.03 GiB each
basis.validation_scores: 81 immutable fold-condition payloads across three methods; exact row counts are materialised and audited before launch
basis.overhead_policy: remaining allowance covers model cache manifests logs telemetry and filesystem rounding

formal_release_requirements: official test remains sealed and test-contract count equals zero
all checkpoint score-shard sync and restore tests pass
the three worker manifests form the exact dependency-closed 150-job union
the result assignment contains exactly 81 validation payloads
RunPod source commit equals the reviewed and pushed Git commit
startup GPU CUDA package input-hash storage thermal resume and replication gates pass
no unneeded Pod is active before launch
stop_conditions: official-test access or any test contract
hash-incompatible resume or local overwrite conflict
held-out validation labels used for parameter selection
third sentiment emitted for an aspect
automatic local replication is not healthy
